scope: Per-native-copper UUID reviews. Partial A1:1 top route and local R3/R4.1/R5/R6.1 supply connection and separate R6.3/R9.9 supply link, with estimated pad attachments. Photo-supported geometry is not measured continuity; hidden continuations and the output clock source remain unresolved. BR1/R10.3 has one inferred bottom segment supported by local joint correspondence; it does not qualify global bottom registration. R10.1/R10.2 output branches end at observed solder eyes; further A1/cable connectivity remains unresolved.
